newsitem.title: USA: Elan rectal gel for epilepsy gets FDA nod.
newsitem.headline: Elan rectal gel for epilepsy gets FDA nod.

text.p: Elan Corp said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved its Diastat diazepam rectal gel to treat epilepsy.

Most epilepsy patients can control seizures with daily medication, but some with severe epilepsy suffer from periodic clusters of prolonged, acute seizures which can lead to brain damage, serious injury or death if not treated quickly. The gel is aimed at those patients, Elan said.

The FDA had previously granted the company orphan drug status for Diastat, providing seven years of marketing exclusivity. Diastat will be available, pre-filled, in adult and pediatric sizes and in a range of doses.
Elan Corp Plc is based in Ireland.
